question.problem:
The distance covered per game by a particular soccer player is uniformly distributed between $10\,\text{km}$
 and $13\,\text{km}$ inclusive. What is the probability that this player runs $12\,\text{km}$ or more in a randomly selected game?
question.worked_solution:
Let $X$ represent the distance covered by the player. From the problem statement, we know that $X∼U[10,13],$ and we wish to compute $P(X\ge 12).$

In general, if $X∼U[a,b],$ then $X$ has the following probability density function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{b-a}, & a\le x\le b \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

So, for our random variable $X∼U[10,13],$ we have the following probability density function:

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{3}, & 10\le x\le 13 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge 12) & ={\int }_{12}^{13}f(x)\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\int }_{12}^{13}\frac{1}{3}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={\frac{x}{3}|}_{12}^{13} \\  & =\frac{13}{3}-\frac{12}{3} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
